text: NAINIL PATEL QA & SOFTWARE TESTING INTERN Valsad, Gujarat • nainil9845patel@gmail.com • +91 9313499676 • GitHub: nainilpatel102 CAREER OBJECTIVE Motivated Computer Engineering student with hands-on experience building full-stack web applications, seeking a QA / Software Testing Internship to apply my understanding of the software development lifecycle to identify defects, write test cases, and ensure product quality. Currently upskilling in manual testing, API testing, and test automation basics. A developer background helps me understand how bugs are introduced — making me a more effective tester. Hospital Management System | 3rd Semester | Team Project HTML · CSS · JavaScript · PHP · MySQL • Developed a web-based system for patient records, doctor appointment scheduling, and billing for hospital staff and patients. • Tested role-based authentication flows — including incorrect credentials, session expiry, and unauthorized route access — to validate secure login behavior. • Verified data integrity across all CRUD operations by cross-checking MySQL records after patient registration, scheduling, and billing updates. • Identified and resolved 5+ bugs during self-testing, including form re-submission errors and incorrect date validation in the appointment module.
